$description: ORIVILO component tokens. Each references a semantic token only (DESIGN.md §5); a recipe (src/recipes/recipes.css) reads one name per slot and a component consumes the recipe class. The first components land with E2-4.

input-group.$description: InputGroup: one outline around an input and its start and end slots (ORV-67). Edge, ground, height and type come from the input group; these are the slot-only values

inset.$description: Gap between the outline and a Button inside a slot

border.$description: Transparent on the light canvas (mood E: borderless cards); marks the edge in dark

value-type.$description: Digits only; the tight tracking never reaches Thai text (DESIGN.md §3.3)

body-bleed.$description: How far the scrolling body bleeds past its box so a control's focus ring (2 px plus a 2 px gap) is not clipped

destructive.$description: The glyph before a destructive title; the confirming Button is destructive too

toast.$description: A short notice that does not block (E4-5): saved, generation failed

description-fg.$description: The second line; the inverse ground has no muted step that keeps 4.5, so it differs by type, not colour

line-gap.$description: Between the content and the description

dot.$description: The dot before the word: the variant's own feedback ink, never the brand accent for a status (ORV-68)

bg.$description: A table is a card on the canvas

fg-missing.$description: A cell the data did not fill reads the missing label in tertiary ink, never blank

numeric-type.$description: Numeric columns: mono tabular figures, end-aligned

row-hover.$description: The well, not surface.hover: in dark a control's edge keeps 3.0 on it under every profile

status-padding.$description: Block padding of the loading, empty and error row

size-sm.$description: The small box for tables and dense lists (ORV-72)

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.5.8: the small box keeps a 24 px target when its label is visually hidden. Borrows size.icon.lg (24) because no semantic target size exists; retuning icon sizes moves this floor

fg-destructive.$description: A destructive item, last in its menu

bg-hover-destructive.$description: The destructive item's ground while highlighted

description-fg.$description: Second line of a Select option

icon-size.$description: Icon before a Select option label, 16

shortcut-fg.$description: Shortcut hint at the end of an item

radius.$description: The hover tint behind a tab is a small rounded rectangle; the pill radius on a top edge reads as a dome, and the selected state is the 2 px edge, not the shape

item-gap.$description: Gap between the icon, the label and the count

count-fg.$description: A number the caller passes; never computed here

radius.$description: A multi-line box takes the media radius, not the pill: a pill wrapping three lines reads as a capsule, not a field

counter-fg-over.$description: Past the limit: danger ink, the only over-limit colour (DESIGN.md §8)

counter-gap.$description: Between the textarea and its counter

selection-opacity.$description: Box-select fill, selection at this opacity

border.$description: Transparent on the light board like a card; marks the edge in dark

note-bg.$description: A note is glass (owner, 2026-10-22, ORV-56): a share of this over the board with a blur, like the toolbar; solid under reduced transparency

note-border.$description: The glass needs an edge on the light board, as the toolbar has

header-bg.$description: The solid form of the glass header frame: shown under reduced transparency or without backdrop blur, and the ground the header text pairs are proven on (the glass tint over the card reads lighter than this in light mode and is the same step in dark)

glass-tint.$description: The glass header frame (owner, ORV-59): a thin share of this over the card, a lighter top edge and a hairline ring, with a backdrop blur

frame-inset.$description: 4 px between the node edge and the glass header frame (owner, ORV-59); the frame's radius is the node's less this, and it pads by node.padding less this, so its text lines up with the body

kind-fg.$description: The kind word next to the title

chip-bg.$description: The square behind the kind icon, cut out of the header frame (ORV-57)

ring-start.$description: The ring that turns around a running node

fg-missing.$description: Missing inputs: the node asks the engine, so the intent colour

radius.$description: 24, the overlay level (owner, ORV-59): soft like the dialogs and command palette, so the glass header frame inside stays concentric at 20

border-empty.$description: An empty block node (ORV-44 part 2): a dashed frame in this colour; the fill word carries the state

swatch-border.$description: The hairline around a colour swatch in a summary, so a colour near the card still has an edge

ring.$description: A ring the colour of the node so the port reads on the node edge

fg-valid.$description: A compatible drop target while connecting

fg-invalid.$description: An incompatible drop target, with the reason

flow-start.$description: An edge feeding a running node, and the line drawn while connecting: the source end

flow-light.$description: The light that travels along a feeding edge

bg.$description: A frame lighter than the board in light, the card value in dark

radius.$description: 24, the same as a node (ORV-59); the group's padding keeps its nodes clear of its edge

kbd.$description: A key cap in a menu, tooltip or the shortcut sheet (E4-3)

toggle.$description: ToggleGroup, segmented: a sunken track; the pressed item is a raised card chip with a ring and heavier text, never a selection tint or the canvas violet, so it reads the same under every profile (ORV-65)

command.$description: The command menu (Mod+K): the one glass palette (ui-direction)

group-fg.$description: Secondary, not tertiary: the heading sits on glass, which reads darker than its token

scroll-area.$description: A panel with its own scroll (E4-4): block library, inspector

slider.$description: A bounded number with an immediate effect (E4-4): density, strength, zoom

resizable.$description: The handle between a side panel and the board (E4-4)

side-sheet.$description: A side panel over the board for a longer task (E4-4): the inspector on small screens

shelf.$description: The block library shelf at the bottom of the board (ORV-44 part 2): glass like the toolbar, tiles grouped by module

bg.$description: Solid base of the glass; text pairs are proven on it

module-fg.$description: The module heading above a group of tiles

tile-border.$description: A tile already on the board: solid edge; not on the board: dashed

tile-ring-start.$description: A tile already on the board: its edge is the AI gradient (owner, 2026-10-22); not on the board: dashed tile-border

tile-ring-width.$description: 2 px, one step lighter than a running node's ring

tile-state-fg.$description: The state word under the block name

tile-width.$description: Every tile is this wide, so the shelf reads as one row of equal tiles; a long name is cut with an ellipsis and its full text is the tile's title

prompt.$description: MissingInputsPrompt (ORV-44 part 2): one question at a time for a node that still needs inputs

done-fg.$description: The line that says the node has what it needs

inspector.$description: The panel beside the board for the selected node (ORV-44 part 3)

muted-fg.$description: Meta line, counts, the rule label and empty lines

divider.$description: The line under the header and between source rows

direction.$description: DirectionStudio (ORV-34 part 2): a brief, what the rules read from it, two directions and one shared live preview

sample-bg.$description: The ground of a direction's small sample, under that direction's profile

progress.$description: How far a job has got (E4-5): a bar, a label and the value as text

tag.$description: A removable or selectable label the user chose (E4-5): a reference, a filter, a mention
